run.name: Century Communities, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CCS)
run.summary: Century Communities has a weakened but liquid credit profile: leverage is 6.16x adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow is negative, offset by USD 744.0 million of undrawn revolver and no bond maturity before August 2029. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, company-defined, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 1,812.587 (Q3 10-Q page:14) over LTM adjusted EBITDA 294.366, derived as FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025 (10-K page:91; Q3 10-Q page:65). Cash and cash equivalents 86.086 (Q3 10-Q page:2). Debt is at the balance sheet date; the HistoryMaker Homes acquisition of October 7, 2026 is not included. Using unadjusted EBITDA the ratios are 2.83x, 5.07x and 7.68x total, and 2.54x, 4.69x and 7.31x net (see Calculations).

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 349.705 (10-K page:91) over cash interest paid of approximately 81.3 (10-K page:43, page:130). Unadjusted EBITDA gives 3.50x.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents (Q3 10-Q page:2). Commitment 1,200.0 after the September 30, 2026 First Amendment (Q3 10-Q page:16) less 456.0 drawn (Q3 10-Q page:17). Excludes escrow 33.740. Company-reported liquidity 863.8 equals cash 86.086 plus escrow 33.740 plus 744.0 (Q3 10-Q page:52). Letters of credit of 42.3 are issued under unspecified facilities (Q3 10-Q page:26); if all sat under the revolver, undrawn capacity would be 701.7. Mortgage repurchase and construction loan headroom is excluded (see Liquidity and covenants).

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, post-acquisition funding and 2026 cash interest are not in the sources.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels are not in the sources, and cash interest paid is disclosed only for full years.
